Definition: Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Chenaanah = "trader"; 1) father of Zedekiah the false prophet of Ahab; 2) son of Bilhan, grandson of Jediael, and great grandson of Benjamin and the founder of a house of Benjamin
